:::note[このページについて]
[s1000d-brex-mcp](/s1000d-stack/ja/mcp/brex-mcp/) 0.8.1 の `tools/list` の応答から生成したページです。設定のしかたと応答の読み方は、s1000d-brex-mcp のページにあります。
:::

## 概要

データモジュールを BREX に照合し、違反を箇所（XPath と行番号）・実際の値・ルール ID・説明・重大度付きで返します。既定では `brexDmRef` の連鎖をたどり、各層に個別に照合します

## `tools/list` が返す説明

LLM が受け取る説明の原文（英語）です。

> Check a data module against BREX rules and report violations with location (XPath + line), actual value, rule id, objectUse text and severity. Also accepts a publication module (pm) or a comment (the brexDmRef in pmStatus / commentStatus is followed). By default follows the document's brexDmRef chain (project BREX → … → the BREX that ends the chain by referring to itself: usually the S1000D default BREX found under S1000D_SPEC_DIR) and checks each layer separately; pass "brex" to check against one specific BREX instead or in addition. Does NOT validate against the XML schema (XSD): run schema validation separately. nonContextRules cannot be checked automatically and are returned as manualChecks.

## 引数

`inputSchema` の内容です。入れ子の引数は `親.子`、配列の要素は `親[].子` と書いています。説明は原文（英語）です。

| 名前 | 型 | 必須 | 値の制約 | 説明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | `string` |  |  | File path of the data module to check. |
| `xml` | `string` |  |  | The data module as an XML string (alternative to path; max 5 MB). |
| `brex` | `string` |  |  | A specific BREX (file path or DMC) to check against. With followChain=false it is the only layer; otherwise it is added to the chain. |
| `followChain` | `boolean` |  | 既定値 `true` | Follow the brexDmRef chain of the data module (default true). |
| `csdbDirs` | `array<string>` |  |  | CSDB folders to search for BREX by DMC (default: S1000D_CSDB_DIR / the config file; S1000D_SPEC_DIR is always searched for the S1000D default BREX). When given, these folders replace S1000D_CSDB_DIR and the csdbDirs of the config file (they are not added to them); folders that do not exist are skipped and reported in _notes. |
| `includeManualChecks` | `boolean` |  | 既定値 `true` | Include nonContextRules as manualChecks in each layer (default true). |
| `maxViolationsPerLayer` | `number` |  | 既定値 `200` | Cap on violations returned per layer (default 200). The total count is always reported. |
